description: Header file defining thread-safe lazy initialization utility functions using atomics and spin-locks within the starboard namespace.

methods.name: EnsureInitialized
methods.description: Checks and sets the initialization state in a thread-safe manner, returning false if initialization is needed.

methods.name: IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the given state is initialized.

methods.name: SetInitialized
methods.description: Sets the given state as initialized.
